character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: warm chestnut hair in a high ponytail, clear amber eyes, a calm, observant face; a thoughtful everyday traveler with a keen eye for small moments, wearing a recognizable contemporary outfit with a signature jacket, simple accessories, and comfortable shoes with magenta accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in coastal expressway at dusk, retro city boulevard, neon-lit record shop; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with teal blue, magenta, warm amber, midnight navy; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by cinematic wide shot, tracking shot beside a retro car, close-up portrait with city bokeh; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
